title: DNS Leak Exposure by Device
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dnsleak:check
| stats count(eval(leak_detected="true")) as leak_checks count as checks by device_name
| sort 0 - leak_checks
description: Ranks devicess by DNS leak exposure.
value: Device-level leak exposure helps separate one misconfigured laptop or phone from a whole-network issue.
implementation: Send DNS leak exposure events to `index=personal` and keep `device_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of DNS leak exposure by devices.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which devicess stand out most for DNS leak exposure.
